body:
town_ability_for_slot's hardcoded job/slot if-chain now delegates the WHICH-ability-per-slot decision to a real PARENA mod (PARENA/stdlib/gfd/action_bar_mod.prn -> on_gfd_ability_for_slot, generated C committed). Chosen over the still-unscoped federated EduScript<->PARENA process model in docs2/MOD_SURFACE_NORTHSTAR.md $3a -- reused ECOWAR's already-live static-link mod pattern instead (full reasoning in that doc's new $7). Found and fixed a real live build gap: PARENA's current runtime/parena_runtime.h doesn't compile under Emscripten (forkpty), fixed by pinning GFD's own copy to the original minimal runtime (git rev 9bdf91e), same precedent ECOWAR already set. Verified via a 20-assertion standalone C probe, a full native link, and a full WASM build redeployed live (4/4 artifacts curl-200-verified). PARENA commit 5b24fde, GoblinFoxDragon commit 410a79e.

⚓ ☃
title: GFD-MACRO-0012: action bar tied into a real PARENA mod
